verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say ACH transfers take 1–3 business days, wires (domestic and international) can send same-day, and users see the exact delivery estimate before confirming. That directly matches the story. Community reviews add context that same-day ACH is available on the Pro plan, but none confirm the pre-confirmation estimate display. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the estimate is shown (specific date vs. range, cutoff-time handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of the estimate screen.
